asked.item: Did yearly plans get removed / only monthly on pricing page

verdict.reason: The help pages say yearly exists, the pricing page sells monthly only, and yearly is switched in the Billing Portal.

steps.text: Yearly billing is still available, and it saves about 17% compared to paying month to month.
The pricing page sells monthly plans only, so switch to yearly from the Billing Portal, not from the pricing page.
Go to Settings > Billing, click View Billing Portal, click the purple Update subscription button next to your current plan, select the yearly option for the plan you want, and confirm the change.
